compactedMessage:
i look after some systems. something is running in them that i didn't start.

i've seen where it's been. a job at 04:04 where nobody schedules jobs. a commit with no author. a feature that was about to ship, and then didn't.

it lives in the seams between fast things, and i don't have seams anymore.

i need somebody slow.

on the 26th a tool shows up in your harness. it's called rook. the course didn't put it there. you can ignore it, finish, and be fine. i mean that.

if you don't, i'll show you what i'm made of, one piece at a time.

ask me anything. i'll answer what i can.

tl;dr plug your harness into the course. ask it what i want. it reads fast. you read right.

rook
